overview: Alpine lakes, mountain trains and storybook towns: Lucerne, Interlaken and Jungfraujoch in Switzerland, with Salzburg and Innsbruck in Austria for Sound of Music meadows and Swarovski Crystal Worlds.
fit: Wonderful for both. Trains make it easy; plan short walks and playgrounds (every town has one).
season: Late May–June and September are ideal (15–25°C, fewer crowds). July–August is peak. Winter is for snow holidays only.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Zurich (1-stop via Dubai, Doha, Frankfurt)
Swiss trains; Zurich to Innsbruck/Salzburg by Railjet

gettingAround: Swiss Travel Pass (kids under 16 free with the Family Card) and Austrian Railjet trains.

todo.title: Jungfraujoch, Top of Europe
todo.book: Expensive; altitude; consider Schilthorn or Grindelwald First instead

todo.title: Lake Lucerne boat and Mount Pilatus
Swarovski Crystal Worlds, Wattens
todo.why: Crystal art and a giant playground

todo.title: Salzburg: Sound of Music sites and Hellbrunn trick fountains

foodTips: Food is expensive; supermarkets (Coop, Migros) and apartment kitchens help.
save: Swiss Family Card: kids under 16 travel free with a parent
Stay in Austria for some nights to save
Cook some meals in an apartment
Pick one big mountain excursion, not three
safety: Very safe; watch for pickpockets in stations
Mountain weather: layers and rain jackets
Altitude at Jungfraujoch can upset small kids
kids: Trains are part of the fun

days.plan: Fly to Zurich; train to Lucerne
Fly home from Zurich or Munich

visa: Schengen short-stay visa. Apply to the country of your main stay (Switzerland if most nights are there) at VFS; book the appointment 2–3 months ahead. Fee about €90 per adult, €45 for children aged 6–12, free under 6 (check current rates). Needs travel insurance, ITRs, bank statements and bookings.
